evaluation_contract.callable_mask: only A/C/G/T bases; N and other IUPAC bases are excluded from class denominators and reported separately
evaluation_contract.d_binary: N/A for class metrics; WHOLE D output is binary material only and is not remapped into classes
evaluation_contract.full8_endpoint: 8-by-8 reference-row/prediction-column confusion on all callable bases; source Unknown/UNCLASSIFIED remains an explicit row
evaluation_contract.primary_known_endpoint: macro metrics over reference BG/SINE/LINE/LTR/DNA positions only; source KNOWN_OTHER_TE, AMBIGUOUS_TE and UNCLASSIFIED positions are excluded from this denominator
evaluation_contract.source_mapping: same frozen SF5 ontology policy as the matched class trainer: BG default, SINE/LINE/LTR/DNA main classes, RC/Retroposon KNOWN_OTHER_TE, ? AMBIGUOUS_TE, Unknown/Unspecified/unresolved UNCLASSIFIED
evaluation_contract.source_overlap_policy: sort source intervals by (start,end,ontology_label_id), then ordered paint; later row wins
evaluation_contract.true_te_endpoint: conditional readout on reference SINE/LINE/LTR/DNA bases, with per-class exact recall and any-main-TE recovery
evaluation_contract.truth_boundary: same-assembly UCSC RepeatMasker is a comparator layer, not exhaustive biological truth; native unknown and source unknown are never silently treated as negative
evaluation_contract.unknown_reporting: source Unknown/UNCLASSIFIED and AMBIGUOUS_TE bp/rows are reported in full even when excluded from primary known denominator

model_contract.checkpoint_contract: validation-selected best_model from class job 12889091; no test or chromosome score selection
model_contract.name: NTv2-500M
model_contract.prediction: native 8-class token argmax projected back to covered bases; no threshold or calibration
model_contract.token_projection: representation trainer sequence_tokens: six-base tokens plus a final shorter token, non-ACGT token mapped to native <unk>
